requirement: Also accept a days unit "d" worth 86400 seconds. It comes first in the unit order, which becomes d, h, m, s (so "2d3h" is valid and "3h2d" is "unit out of order: d"). Every other rule and error message is unchanged.
desc: Parse a duration such as "1d1h30m15s" into a number of seconds. s is one or more components; each component is one or more decimal digits (leading zeros allowed) followed by a unit letter: d (86400 seconds), h (3600), m (60) or s (1). Units must appear in the order d, h, m, s, each at most once; any of them may be omitted. Errors: "empty" for the empty string. Otherwise scan s from left to right; at each character that is not a digit, check in this order: "unknown unit: X" if X is not d, h, m or s; "missing number before X" if no digits come directly before X; "unit out of order: X" if unit X is not later in the order d, h, m, s than every unit seen before. If s ends with digits that have no unit, return "missing unit". Report the first error found.

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
